prospective_registered_decision.conclusion: Prospective CPU information diagnostic, no new fit. No genotype signal, calibration or independent confirmation conclusion yet.
prospective_registered_decision.hypothesis: The fixed H028 genotype composite may carry ancestry or complementary error signal that the small residual head did not use. Direct sealed fields and conditional error diagnostics can distinguish weak evidence from an ineffective readout.
prospective_registered_decision.method: Reuse exact H028 observed allele function/10kb windows/1kb density weights/alpha.5. Seal raw uncentered younger-cohort C4 fields on exact original Q120/readout bins for all4 parents before truth arrays. Explicit no-called-window fallback is observed younger donor-count prior[24,16,22,22]/84 with coverage reporting. Then unchanged span scorer and existing completed VAL baseline/genotype seals assess direct accuracy, per-class/boundaries and baseline-correct/wrong complementarity. Selected head/logit scales and source-only field variance/callability documented.
prospective_registered_decision.novelty_assessment: Diagnostic of established allele-frequency composite, not a new classifier contribution. Normalized composite evidence is not a calibrated independent SNP likelihood.
prospective_registered_decision.repeat_policy: A direct-field and conditional-error question not answered by H028 residual fits. No new window/LD/temperature tuning or additional optimizer seeds. No invented TRAIN baseline or genotype classifier superiority claim.
